row: Kids Saving the Rainforest (KSTR) is a 501 (c)(3) non-profit organization founded in 1999 in Manuel Antonio, Costa Rica dedicated to the preservation of rainforest and its inhabitants. Our mission is to educate children about the rainforest, reforest local land, rehabilitate and provide sanctuary for wildlife in need, and ensure the survival of the Titi monkey.
